issue_request: FHIR-32801 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request asking that MedicationKnowledge change from DomainResource to MetadataResource so it can be referenced and managed through canonical and metadata resource patterns. The resolution also said to remove or replace local identifier, author, and status elements as needed, and the Jira comment clarified that all MetadataResource and CanonicalResource data elements should be available.
initial_application: Git commit dc170b26ef270aa638b21e96e615b162e17b6d06 changed the MedicationKnowledge baseDefinition from DomainResource to MetadataResource but did not align retained local identifier, status, author, name, search parameter, or example wording. Later related commits applied FHIR-45285, FHIR-45284, and FHIR-42901 changes for interface compatibility, template declaration, and jurisdiction naming.
additional_context: MedicationKnowledge is active in source/fhir.ini. Later applied issue FHIR-45285 is already represented on the combined branch by audit commit fe7a179beccbcce2f459e6b34bc98aa577952b07, so no duplicate FHIR-45285 commit was published. FHIR-42901 and FHIR-45284 constrain the interpretation of the seed issue. The checked-in SVG and old MedicationKnowledgeStatus terminology still contain obsolete text, but the SVG is generated-looking and the old status terminology is no longer referenced by the authoritative binding or active fhir.ini terminology entries.
reconciliation: Changed source/medicationknowledge/structuredefinition-MedicationKnowledge.xml so the entered-in-error marker uses retired, identifier/status/author/name definitions use metadata/canonical artifact semantics, status binding metadata names PublicationStatus, and name carries the canonical name constraint. Updated MedicationKnowledge identifier/status search parameter descriptions and changed the example name to a machine-friendly canonical name while leaving the medication display in code.text.
